name: Notion AI
tagline: AI teammate inside Notion: writing, workspace Q&A, agents, and meeting notes.
description: Notion AI is the assistant built into the Notion workspace, drafting and editing content, answering questions across your pages and connected apps, taking AI meeting notes, and running custom agents on triggers or schedules. Enterprise Search reaches into Slack, Google Drive, and GitHub, and the Notion Agent can complete multi-step tasks with workspace context.
insight: It runs a multi-model picker (Claude among them) and treats models as swappable — when Anthropic models degraded in June 2026, it rerouted.

modelSupport.notes: Model picker routes across providers; full AI (Agent, Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search) lands on Business and Enterprise plans.

edge: Native to the workspace where your notes already live; Enterprise Search reaches into Slack, Drive, and GitHub.
pros: AI meeting notes and custom agents
cons: Value depends on living in Notion
Add-on pricing on top of Notion seats
Search quality varies by workspace hygiene
